subject: old version of unit class is no longer allowed, from R version 3.X to 4.0.0

messages.author: c004874b7ad62b9c
messages.subject: old version of unit class is no longer allowed, from R version 3.X to 4.0.0
parts:
Somebody have reported exactly the same issue I have encountered.
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62067331/cant-plot-ggplot2-objects-created-with-r-3-x-into-r-4-x-imported-from-a-rds-fil#new-answer
Seems like there is no solution for now.

I developed a shiny app, which required tens of thousands of pre-calculated ggplot objects, which were all saved as individual .RDS files.
If the only option is to redo the precalculation under R 4.0.0, I will be mentally devastated.
Any suggestions?

Thanks.

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: old version of unit class is no longer allowed, from R version 3.X to 4.0.0
parts:
The best thing for you to do would be to reinstall R 3.6 and plot those plots how you need to. The issues as Claus pointed out are with unit change in grid which is not ggplot2, it is a component of base R itself and the improvements in terms of speed of plotting are substantial.

Can you reinstall an older R version and output what you need?

B

and you're set.
